name: Songblade Search

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know expedition crews and archaeological digs are common across Khaz Modan. The Wetlands beyond Loch Modan are dangerous, and journeys there put kin at risk.
As an Alliance traveler, you may pass excavation sites on the way between Loch Modan and Menethil Harbor. There, you can aid stranded dwarven prospectors and artisans.

faq.answer: Dorin Songblade asks travelers to check on his brother. Work refitting girdles fills the artisan's hands, so he could not join Daewyn's archaeological dig.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Songblade Search?

faq.answer: Daewyn Songblade is Dorin Songblade's brother. He left with an excavation crew from Loch Modan for the Wetlands hills, but has not sent word as he usually does.
Daewyn is at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands. His resemblance to Dorin and the DLS initials carved into his rifle's wooden stock identify him.

aliases: why did daewyn go to wetlands
why did the dwarfs go to wetlands
faq.answer: Daewyn traveled to the Wetlands with a dwarven digging expedition from Loch Modan to excavate unexplored hills.
faq.q: Why did Daewyn travel to the Wetlands?

faq.answer: The initials DLS carved into the rifle stock belong to Daewyn Songblade. They identify the dwarf at the excavation site as Dorin's missing brother.
faq.q: What do the initials carved on the gun mean?

faq.answer: Dorin worries because Daewyn usually writes promptly after setting out. No letters have come since Daewyn left for the Wetlands, and Dorin fears something has gone wrong.
faq.q: Why was Dorin worried about his brother?

sections.body: Dorin Songblade tends his workshop, buried in orders to refit girdles. His brother Daewyn has gone north with a dwarven excavation crew from Loch Modan. The hills they seek in the Wetlands have never felt a dwarven pickaxe. Daewyn usually writes as soon as he arrives, but no word has reached Dorin, and the silence unsettles him.
sections.title: A Brother's Unease

sections.body: Daewyn Songblade digs at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands. He looks much like his brother Dorin and carries a rifle with DLS carved into its wooden stock. Those initials mark Daewyn at the remote excavation camp in the marshlands.
sections.title: The Dig in the Wetlands

summary: Dorin Songblade waits for word from his brother Daewyn in the Wetlands. Daewyn joined an archaeological crew from Loch Modan to dig in unexplored hills, but his silence is unlike him.
